componentAdoption.probeScope: Each exact upstream source was rewritten as one entry with current nova CSS. Sibling dependency closures were not materialized. Some K9 diagnostics can depend on that limit; retained direct Base UI/Radix imports and intrinsic JSX do not.

blockers.reason: Root snapPoints/swipeDirection, Viewport/Popup/Content, and swipe/nested-drawer geometry depend on the Base UI behavior engine. An import alias alone cannot reproduce them through React Aria.
The existing transform preserves both imports. The referenced Collapsible source also imports radix-ui.
Output preserves intrinsic elements, nested SidebarMenuSub markup, and unbound width variables.

componentAdoption.repairBoundary: Some output alias/token bindings are possible within existing output paths. Completing the required Drawer engine replacement and all raw-element/runtime gates requires behavior adaptation or further authenticated transform work; neither was represented as adopted output.
